description: Copies what you point at in a BB Browser tab: pick any element and get a structured markdown block — page URL, viewport, CSS selector, ARIA role and name, bounds, link, and text — or a PNG of just that element, or a screenshot of the visible tab. One icon button in the thread header opens the three modes, and the picker outlines each target with a hover highlight and label as you move. Redaction is a heuristic on form fields — a password input, or a name, id or autocomplete matching password, credential, secret, token, api-key or auth — so it covers more than passwords but nothing outside an input, and images are not redacted.
